cases.sentence: Ей, благодаря этому знакомству, открылся совершенно новый ___, не имеющий ничего общего с ее прошедшим.
cases.translation: Thanks to this acquaintance, a completely new world opened up to her, one that had nothing in common with her past.
cases.explain: Мир is the grammatical subject of открылся (opened up), so it stands in the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Мысль ___ Евангелия преступникам, как это делала Алин, особенно прельщала Китти.
cases.translation: The idea of reading the Gospel to criminals, as Aline did, especially charmed Kitty.
cases.explain: Чтения depends on the noun мысль (the thought of reading), a noun-of-noun relationship that takes the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Ей, благодаря этому ___, открылся совершенно новый мир.
cases.translation: Thanks to this acquaintance, a completely new world opened up to her.
cases.explain: The preposition благодаря (thanks to) governs the dative case.

cases.sentence: В котором велено подставить другую щеку, когда ударят по одной, и отдать ___, когда снимают кафтан?
cases.translation: In which one is commanded to turn the other cheek when struck, and give up one's shirt when one's coat is taken?
cases.explain: Рубашку is the direct object of отдать (to give up), so it takes the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Это была религия возвышенная, таинственная, связанная с ___ прекрасных мыслей и чувств.
cases.translation: It was a lofty, mysterious religion, bound up with a series of beautiful thoughts and feelings.
cases.explain: The preposition с (with) governs the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Мадам Шталь старательно держала свое лицо в ___ абажура и особенно улыбалась.
cases.translation: Madame Stahl carefully kept her face in the shade of the lampshade and smiled in a particular way.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) governs the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Варенька, одинокая, без родных, без друзей, с грустным ___, ничего не желавшая, ничего не жалевшая, была тем самым совершенством.
cases.translation: Varenka, alone, without family, without friends, with sad disillusionment, wanting nothing, regretting nothing, was that very perfection.
cases.explain: The preposition с (with) governs the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Знакомство это вместе с дружбой к ___ не только имело на нее сильное влияние.
cases.translation: This acquaintance, together with the friendship toward Varenka, not only had a strong influence on her.
cases.explain: The preposition к (toward) governs the dative case.

reading.ru: Китти познакомилась и с госпожою Шталь, и знакомство это вместе с дружбой к Вареньке не только имело на нее сильное влияние, но утешало ее в ее горе.
reading.question: What effect did Kitty's acquaintance with Madame Stahl and her friendship with Varenka have on her?
options: It had a strong influence on her and comforted her in her grief
It made her angry at her family
It had no effect on her at all
It made her want to leave for Moscow immediately
reading.correct: It had a strong influence on her and comforted her in her grief
reading.explain: The text says the acquaintance and friendship strongly influenced Kitty and comforted her in her grief.

reading.ru: Ей открылось то, что кроме жизни инстинктивной, которой до сих пор отдавалась Китти, была жизнь духовная.
reading.question: What new understanding did Kitty gain?
options: That besides the instinctive life she had lived, there was a spiritual life
That she should abandon religion entirely
That her family was wealthier than she thought
reading.correct: That besides the instinctive life she had lived, there was a spiritual life
reading.explain: The text states it was revealed to her that besides her instinctive life, there existed a spiritual life.

reading.ru: Мадам Шталь говорила с Китти как с милым ребенком, на которого любуешься, как на воспоминания своей молодости, и только один раз упомянула о том, что во всех людских горестях утешение дает лишь любовь и вера, и что для сострадания к нам Христа нет ничтожных горестей, и тотчас же перевела разговор на другое.
reading.question: How did Madame Stahl speak to Kitty?
options: As to a dear child one admires, like a memory of one's youth
As an equal colleague in religious study
She refused to speak to her at all
reading.correct: As to a dear child one admires, like a memory of one's youth
reading.explain: The text says Madame Stahl spoke to Kitty as to a dear child, admired like a memory of her own youth.

reading.ru: Она заметила, что, расспрашивая про ее родных, мадам Шталь улыбнулась презрительно, что было противно христианской доброте.
reading.question: What did Kitty notice that troubled her about Madame Stahl?
options: Madame Stahl smiled contemptuously when asked about her relatives, contrary to Christian kindness
Madame Stahl refused to eat with her
Madame Stahl spoke rudely to Varenka
Madame Stahl never smiled at all
reading.correct: Madame Stahl smiled contemptuously when asked about her relatives, contrary to Christian kindness
reading.explain: Kitty noticed Madame Stahl's contemptuous smile when asked about her family, which was contrary to Christian kindness.

reading.ru: Но зато Варенька, одинокая, без родных, без друзей, с грустным разочарованием, ничего не желавшая, ничего не жалевшая, была тем самым совершенством, о котором только позволяла себе мечтать Китти.
reading.question: How did Kitty view Varenka?
options: As the very perfection she allowed herself to dream of
As a foolish and naive girl
As someone to be pitied and avoided
As less admirable than Madame Stahl
reading.correct: As the very perfection she allowed herself to dream of
reading.explain: The text describes Varenka as the very perfection Kitty allowed herself to dream of.

reading.ru: Она также, как и племянница госпожи Шталь, Алин, про которую ей много рассказывала Варенька, будет, где бы ни жила, отыскивать несчастных, помогать им сколько можно, раздавать Евангелие, читать Евангелие больным, преступникам, умирающим.
reading.question: What plan did Kitty form for her future life?
options: To seek out the unfortunate, help them, and read the Gospel to the sick, criminals, and the dying, like Aline
To travel the world for pleasure
reading.correct: To seek out the unfortunate, help them, and read the Gospel to the sick, criminals, and the dying, like Aline
reading.explain: Kitty planned to imitate Aline by seeking out unfortunate people and reading the Gospel to the sick, criminals, and dying.

reading.ru: Сначала княгиня замечала только, что Китти находится под сильным влиянием своего онгумо, как она называла госпоже Шталь и в особенности к Вареньке.
reading.question: What did the princess (Kitty's mother) first notice?
options: That Kitty was under the strong influence of her idol, as she called Madame Stahl and especially Varenka
That Kitty wanted to return to Russia immediately
That Kitty had fallen in love with a doctor
reading.correct: That Kitty was under the strong influence of her idol, as she called Madame Stahl and especially Varenka
reading.explain: The princess first noticed Kitty's strong influence from her 'idol,' meaning Madame Stahl and Varenka.

reading.ru: Княгиня видела, что Китти читает по вечерам французское Евангелие, которое ей подарила госпожа Шталь, чего она прежде не делала.
reading.question: What new habit did the princess observe in Kitty?
options: Reading the French Gospel given to her by Madame Stahl in the evenings
Writing letters to her father every night
reading.correct: Reading the French Gospel given to her by Madame Stahl in the evenings
reading.explain: The princess saw Kitty reading the French Gospel Madame Stahl had given her, something she had not done before.

reading.ru: Все это было хорошо, и княгиня ничего не имела против этого, тем более что жена Петрова была вполне порядочная женщина, и что принцесса, заметившая деятельность Китти, хвалила ее, называя ангелом-утешителем.
reading.question: How did the princess (a visiting royal) refer to Kitty because of her charitable activity?
reading.explain: The princess who noticed Kitty's activity praised her, calling her an angel of comfort.

reading.ru: А княгиня видела, что дочь ее впадает в крайность, что она и говорила ей.
reading.question: What concern did Kitty's mother express to her?
options: That she was falling into extremes
That she was not studying enough
That she was too critical of Varenka
reading.correct: That she was falling into extremes
reading.explain: The princess saw that her daughter was falling into extremes and told her so.

reading.ru: Но княгине не нравилось это излишество, и еще более не нравилось то, что она чувствовала, Китти не хотела открыть ей всю свою душу.
reading.question: What bothered the princess even more than Kitty's excess of zeal?
options: That Kitty did not want to open her whole soul to her
That Kitty spent too much money
That Kitty refused to speak to Varenka
reading.correct: That Kitty did not want to open her whole soul to her
reading.explain: The text says the princess disliked even more sensing that Kitty did not want to reveal her whole soul to her.

reading.ru: «Что-то давно Анна Павловна не была у нас», сказала раз княгиня про Петрову.
reading.question: What did the princess remark about Anna Pavlovna?
options: That she had not visited them in a while
That she had moved away permanently
That she no longer liked Kitty
reading.correct: That she had not visited them in a while
reading.explain: The princess remarked that Anna Pavlovna had not been to see them for some time.

reading.ru: «Нет, я не заметила, маман», вспыхнув, сказала Китти.
reading.question: How did Kitty react when her mother asked about Anna Pavlovna?
options: She blushed and said she had not noticed anything
reading.correct: She blushed and said she had not noticed anything
reading.explain: The text says Kitty, blushing, said she had not noticed anything.

reading.ru: В этот же день Варенька пришла обедать и сообщила, что Анна Павловна раздумала ехать завтра в горы.
reading.question: What news did Varenka bring that same day?
options: That Anna Pavlovna had changed her mind about the trip to the mountains
That the family was moving to Moscow
reading.correct: That Anna Pavlovna had changed her mind about the trip to the mountains
reading.explain: Varenka came to dinner and reported that Anna Pavlovna had decided not to go to the mountains the next day.

reading.ru: «Китти, не было ли у тебя чего-нибудь неприятного с Петровыми?» — сказала княгиня, когда они остались одни.
reading.question: What did the princess ask Kitty when they were alone?
options: Whether something unpleasant had happened between her and the Petrovs
Whether she wanted to leave for Russia
Whether she had spoken to her father
reading.correct: Whether something unpleasant had happened between her and the Petrovs
reading.explain: The princess asked Kitty directly whether something unpleasant had occurred between her and the Petrovs.

reading.ru: Она вспоминала наивную радость, выражавшуюся на круглом добродушном лице Анны Павловны при их встречах, вспоминала их тайные переговоры о больном, заговоры о том, чтобы отвлечь его от работы, которая была ему запрещена, и увезти его гулять, привязанность меньшого мальчика, называвшего ее «моя Китти», не хотевшего без нее ложиться спать.
reading.question: What did Kitty recall fondly about her time with the Petrov family?
options: The naive joy on Anna Pavlovna's face and the youngest boy's affection for her, calling her 'my Kitty'
Their frequent complaints about her visits
reading.correct: The naive joy on Anna Pavlovna's face and the youngest boy's affection for her, calling her 'my Kitty'
reading.explain: Kitty remembered Anna Pavlovna's naive joy and the youngest boy's attachment to her, calling her 'my Kitty.'

reading.ru: Потом она вспомнила худую-худую фигуру Петрова с его длинной шеей в его коричневом сюртуке, его редкие вьющиеся волосы, вопросительные, страшные в первое время для Кити голубые глаза и его болезненные старания оказаться бодрым и оживленным в ее присутствии.
reading.question: How did Kitty remember Petrov's appearance?
options: Very thin, with a long neck, sparse curly hair, and questioning blue eyes that once frightened her
Elderly with gray hair and a beard
reading.correct: Very thin, with a long neck, sparse curly hair, and questioning blue eyes that once frightened her
reading.explain: The text describes Petrov as very thin, with a long neck, sparse curly hair, and questioning blue eyes that had frightened Kitty at first.

reading.ru: Анна Павловна притворно встречала Китти и, не переставая, наблюдала ее и мужа.
reading.question: How had Anna Pavlovna's behavior toward Kitty changed?
options: She greeted Kitty falsely and constantly watched her and her husband
She stopped speaking to Kitty entirely
She became warmer and more affectionate
She invited Kitty to live with them
reading.correct: She greeted Kitty falsely and constantly watched her and her husband
reading.explain: The text says Anna Pavlovna greeted Kitty with false friendliness while constantly watching her and her husband.

reading.ru: Это сомнение отравляло прелесть ее новой жизни.
reading.question: What effect did Kitty's doubt have on her?
options: It poisoned the charm of her new life
It made her happier than ever
It had no effect on her at all
It made her decide to leave for Russia immediately
reading.correct: It poisoned the charm of her new life
reading.explain: The text states that this doubt poisoned the charm of her new life.
